answer: Let the past vouch, because it can't be forged later. Each season the economy picks a secret past date, revealed only afterward, and seats only keys that paid real fees on public chains before it, one seat per distinct funding source. Each old key is a relic: a farmer can mint a million keys today but can't backdate one, and since the cutoff is unannounced, pre-aging a garden of spare keys for it means paying fees on all of them for years. A canyon opens between bought-now and lived-then identities.
